elements.description:
One question an agent needs answered before it carries on – numbered options with one recommended, or Approve /
Decline – docked above the composer, folding into a receipt with Undo once sent.

properties.name: agent
properties.description: Who is asking: the agent's name

properties.name: avatar
properties.description: The agent's picture (an image URL); unset shows its initials

properties.name: question
properties.description: The question, as the agent asks it

properties.name: context
properties.description: A line or two of context: what the agent found, why it can't go on alone

properties.name: options
properties.description: The options for kind="choose", in the agent's order

properties.name: allowOther
properties.description: Offers "Something else…" with a short field

properties.name: value
properties.description: The picked option's id ("other" for Something else), or null

properties.name: since
properties.description: When the agent asked, in epoch ms – the header says how long it has waited

properties.name: now
properties.description: The time now, in epoch ms; unset reads the clock, once a minute

properties.name: queue
properties.description: How many decisions wait in all; above 1 the header shows "1 of 3" with previous / next

properties.name: position
properties.description: Which of the waiting decisions this is, from 0

properties.name: sent
properties.description: Sent: the card shows its receipt

properties.name: decision
properties.description: What was sent – the receipt reads it

properties.name: undoMs
properties.description: How long Undo stays on the receipt, in ms (0 hides it)

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Words the page can change, merged over defaultDecisionCardLabels

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: An option was picked ({ value }: DecisionCardValueChange); cancelable – prevented, `value` stays as it was

events.name: tc-decision
events.description: Send, Approve or Decline ({ choice, other?, reason? }: DecisionCardMade); cancelable – unless prevented the card folds into its receipt

events.name: tc-defer
events.description: Later or Escape: the person will decide later ({})

events.name: tc-undo
events.description: Undo on the receipt ({ decision }: DecisionCardUndo); cancelable – unless prevented the card opens again

events.name: tc-position-change
events.description: Previous or next decision in the queue ({ position }: DecisionCardPositionChange); cancelable – prevented, `position` stays

functions.name: DECISION_CARD_OTHER
functions.description: The value of the "Something else…" option, and the choice it sends

functions.name: waitedFor
functions.description: How long it has waited: just now · 4 min · 2 h 10 min · 3 d

props.name: value
props.description: The picked option's id ("other" for Something else). Controlled when defined – pass back what onValueChange reports

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting pick when uncontrolled

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: An option was picked

props.name: position
props.description: Which of the waiting decisions shows, from 0. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description: The starting position when uncontrolled

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Previous or next in the queue

props.name: sent
props.description: Whether it shows its receipt. Controlled when defined – set it after onDecision

props.name: defaultSent
props.description: Whether it starts sent when uncontrolled

props.name: onDecision
props.description: Send, Approve or Decline. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the card open

props.name: onDefer
props.description: Later or Escape

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Undo on the receipt. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the receipt

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: text-wrap: pretty
features.without: Paragraphs may end on a single short word.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
